standard_prerequisites: the exact sequence of completed naive cotangent complexes for A -> B -> C (lemma-exact-sequence-NL of the same chapter)

Artin-Rees consequence: H^{-1} of the completed complex is I-adically complete as a finite module, and equals the limit of its reductions (More on Algebra, Lemma more-algebra-lemma-consequence-Artin-Rees; Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-completion-tensor)
the identification NL^wedge_{B_n/A_n} = NL^wedge_{B/A} tensor B_n (lemma-NL-is-limit of the same chapter)
the algebraic transitivity statement: fibrewise local complete intersection maps give injectivity of the connecting map on H^{-1} (More on Algebra, Lemma more-algebra-lemma-transitive-lci-at-end)
core_obligations: Prove that if B/I^nB -> C/I^nC is a local complete intersection homomorphism for all n, then the map H^{-1}(NL^wedge_{B/A} tensor_B C) -> H^{-1}(NL^wedge_{C/A}) is injective
proof_roadmap: Compute H^{-1}(NL^wedge_{B/A} tensor_B C) as the limit over n of H^{-1}(NL^wedge_{B_n/A_n} tensor C_n), using Artin-Rees completeness for the first equality and lemma-NL-is-limit for the third.
For each n the map to H^{-1}(NL_{C_n/A_n}) is injective by the algebraic transitivity lemma applied to the local complete intersection maps B_n -> C_n.
Since H^{-1}(NL^wedge_{C/A}) is likewise the limit of the H^{-1}(NL_{C_n/A_n}), injectivity passes to the limit.
difficulty_reason: H3: a limit argument transporting a fibrewise algebraic injectivity statement to the completed setting.
